01int binary_cut(vector<int>& wood, int K) {
02    int l = 1;
03    int r = 0;
04    for (int len : wood) r = max(r, len);
05    while (l < r) {
06        int mid = l + (r - l) / 2;
07        if (check(wood, K, mid))
08            ________________; // 在此处填入代码
09        else l = mid + 1;
10    }
11    return l;
12}

01int partition(vector<int>& arr, int low, int high) {
02    int pivot = arr[low];
03    int i = low, j = high;
04    while (i < j) {
05        while (i < j && arr[j] >= pivot) j--;
06        while (i < j && arr[i] <= pivot) i++;
07        if (i < j) swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
08    }
09    ________________; // 在此处填入代码
10    return i;
11}
